description: This file defines a Redux reducer with undo/redo capabilities for dashboard layout state management, including action filtering workaround for a known redux-undo bug.

methods.name: layoutOnlyReducer
methods.description: A wrapper reducer that filters actions to only allow layout-related actions to reach the dashboardLayout reducer, working around a redux-undo filter bug.

methods.name: undoableReducer
methods.description: An undoable reducer created with redux-undo, wrapping layoutOnlyReducer with a limit and initial state ignore.
